PART B
```{r}
id <- (1:8)
name <- c("Alice","Bruno","Chen","Dala","Elif","Farid","Grace","Hiro")
sex <- c("F","M","M","F","F","M","F","M")
sec <- c("A","B","A","C","B","C","A","B")
midterm <- c(78,85,92,67,74,88,95,59)
final <- c(82,79,96,71,80,91,93,65)
att <- c(95,88,100,72,90,85,98,60)
  student_all <-data.frame(
    name = name,
    sex = sex,
    sec =sec,
    midterm = midterm,
    final = final, 
    att = att , stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
student_all

```


```{r}
str(student_all)
dim(student_all)
colnames(student_all)
summary(student_all)
```

```{r}
student_all$avg <- round((student_all$midterm + student_all$final) / 2, 1)
```

```{r}
student_all$passed <- student_all$avg >= 70 & student_all$att >= 75
```

```{r}
student_all$standing <- ifelse(student_all$avg >= 90, "Honors",
ifelse(student_all$avg >= 75, "Passed", "Needs Support"))
```

```{r}
classify_student_all <- function(avg, att) {
  ifelse(avg >= 85, "Distinction",
    ifelse(avg >= 70, "Merit",
      ifelse(avg >= 50 & att >= 50, "Passed", "Fail")))
}
print(student_all)

```

PART C
```{r}
new_students <- data.frame(
id <- c(9,10),
name <- c("Ines","Jamal"),
sec <- c("C","A"),
midterm <- c(81,70),
final <- c(84,68),
att <- c(92,80)
)

student_all<- rbind(new_students)
```

```{r}
quiz <- c(8,7,10,6,7,9,10,5,8,6)
student_all <- cbind(student_all, quiz)
class(student_all)
```

```{r}
m <- cbind(midterm = student_all$midterm, final = student_all$final)
mean_row <- colMeans(student_all[sapply(student_all, is.numeric)], na.rm = TRUE)
student_all <- rbind(student_all, mean = mean_row)
```

```{r}
tryCatch(student_all)
#The standard rbind() function in R throws the error "names do not match previous names".
#This happens if you attempt to combine data frames with different column names.
```
